text:
Theo: Got 30 minutes before bed. Recommend either two songs that feel like a complete mini-set, or one short film under 15 min. Prefer something cozy or slightly odd. :crescent_moon:
Mina: Cozy: Sufjan Stevens - 'Should Have Known Better' (5:12) + Iron & Wine - 'Naked As We Came' (3:05). gentle and wrap-up-y.
Carlos: Odd & short film: 'Validation' (16min) is a tiny feelgood movie (ok slightly over) but hits the heart. link: https://vimeo.com/7049046
Asha: Two-song quirky: Kathleen Edwards - 'In State' (3:40) + Laura Marling - 'What He Wrote' (4:15). folk but with a bite.
Theo: Love the folk picks. Voting time: :musical_note: for songs, :clapper: for film.
Mina: :musical_note:
Carlos: :clapper: (guilty of overestimating time)
Asha: :musical_note:
Theo: Songs win. Also quick shoutout: sys-bot reminded me the rooftop speakers are back online — volume capped at 60% on weeknights. :speaker:
sys-bot: Reminder: Rooftop speaker volume limit set to 60% weekdays 7pm-11pm.
Carlos: Also small reading rec between tracks: Ottessa Moshfegh short piece 'The Invisible Life of Ivan Isaenko' excerpt (one page). weird and sharp.
Mina: Meme: "Planned 30 min wind-down, ended ordering late-night tacos." :taco: :joy:
Theo: Perfect. I'll queue Sufjan + Iron & Wine and try not to taco. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
